items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: she came up there during the program... she personally invited me to come down and play at the Mother's Day program

ctx.x: Well, I had to be around 19 or close to 20. Of course that's a little later on. No, that was in the latter part of the school era, because there was a club -- a men's club over in Pasadena. And they brought me over to the temple as a soloist with their club meeting.
There were -- Miss Mc Pherson had a radio station upstairs. And they came over to do a stint in the station. And they brought me along. And I played a number on the air at her temple.
